subject: HealthLytics: evidence pack & no-train commitment workflow
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Ivanov <sasha@healthlytics.com>, Legal Team <legal@healthlytics.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: HealthLytics – no-train commitment & evidence request

Hi Sasha / HealthLytics legal,

Thanks for the call earlier. To summarize their ask: a contractual "no-training" commitment for any customer-provided data, clear ownership of prompts/responses, and an evidence pack we can deliver during procurement (SOC2, subprocessor list, and a short attestation). They also want to understand cross-border transfer behavior and whether any model telemetry is used for improvement.

Can Neha/Monica and team propose: (1) a short DPA clause they can sign that states no-training of customer data (explicitly excluding aggregated, anonymized telemetry), (2) a one-page evidence checklist we can hand over, and (3) a small operational workflow for how we handle opt-outs and subprocessor notices? Sasha asked if we can provide a firm timeline — procurement needs the pack within 4 business days.

I've attached our current internal "no-train" policy draft for context (redwood-no-train-policy.pdf).

Next steps: Neha — can you draft the DPA snippet + evidence checklist? Monica — please pull the SOC2 and subprocessor exports and confirm any non-US transfers for HealthLytics scope. I put Rishi in the loop for model behavior questions.

Thanks,
Vivek
VP, Product & Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-no-train-policy.pdf

From: Sasha Ivanov <sasha@healthlytics.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Team <legal@healthlytics.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: HealthLytics – no-train commitment & evidence request

Hi Vivek — thanks for following up. Quick clarifications from our procurement/legal: 

- The commitment needs to be explicit that customer data (including prompts, attachments, PII, and any derived responses) will never be used to further train or improve production models.
- We need a copy of your most recent SOC2 Type II report and a full list of subprocessors with locations and contract dates.
- Please confirm retention periods for prompt/response logs, whether logs are pseudonymized or encrypted at rest, and where (which regions) logs may be stored or processed.
- If any inference telemetry is collected (latency, token counts), confirm it is kept strictly anonymized and not used for model training.

Procurement is on a hard timeline (they want to close the DPA next week). Can you also provide a named contact for security evidence delivery? I can share a procurement intake spreadsheet — attaching our privacy questionnaire (healthlytics-privacy-questionnaire.xlsx).

Thanks,
Sasha
Head of Procurement, HealthLytics

Attachment: healthlytics-privacy-questionnaire.xlsx

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Ivanov <sasha@healthlytics.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HealthLytics – no-train commitment & evidence request

Hi Sasha — thanks, this is clear. Below is a concise proposal we can put into the DPA and the evidence pack. I kept the language narrow to minimize legal overhead while meeting your requirements.

Proposed DPA snippets (short form):
- No-Training: "Redwood Inference will not use Customer Data (including prompts, attachments, and generated responses) to train, fine-tune, or otherwise improve production models. Customer Data will not be added to model training corpora without Customer's explicit, written consent."
- Ownership: "Customer retains ownership of prompts and generated responses; Redwood will process and store such data solely to provide the Services in accordance with this DPA."
- Telemetry: "Redwood may collect anonymized service telemetry (e.g., token counts, latency metrics) for service operations and capacity planning. Such telemetry will be aggregated and stripped of any identifiers and will not be used to train production models."

Evidence checklist (we can hand over as PDFs):
1) SOC 2 Type II report (latest) — redacted where required
2) Current subprocessor registry (name, function, country, contract start)
3) Short attestation letter: confirmation of no-training policy for the customer scope
4) Data flow diagram and retention policy excerpt (prompt/response retention: default 30 days; configurable per-account)
5) Encryption & key management statement (KMS/HSM use, in-flight & at-rest encryption)

Operational workflow for opt-out & delivery:
- Step 1: Customer signs DPA with no-train clause and indicates retention preference (default 30 days).
- Step 2: Security prints evidence pack within 2 business days and delivery via secure ShareLink.
- Step 3: Subprocessor notification (if any subprocessor change materially affects the service) — Redwood to notify within 10 business days.

Questions for clarifying items you listed:
- Cross-border transfers: our primary hosted region for your account will be us-west-2; we use transient workers in eu-central-1 for batch jobs in limited cases — we can commit to routing HealthLytics data to us-only processing if required under Dedicated or Private deployment.
- Retention: default 30 days for prompt/response logs; we can RTO to 0 days retention on Dedicated/Private deployments with separate contractual terms.

Timeline: we can assemble the evidence pack and the DPA snippet within 2 business days if we get a signed NDA/permission to share the SOC2 fully. Monica will confirm the SOC2 delivery timeline below.

—Neha
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: HealthLytics – no-train commitment & evidence request

Sasha — appreciated. Short reply and concrete next steps: 

1) Monica will deliver the SOC2 Type II (redacted) and the current subprocessor registry by EOD Monday — Monica, please confirm.
2) Neha will drop the DPA snippet and the one-page evidence checklist into the shared folder and send a secure link to Sasha within 24 hours.
3) Rishi will provide a two-line confirmation on telemetry practices and model improvement isolation (i.e., no customer signals are routed into training pipelines).
4) Vivek to sync with HealthLytics on the retention choice; if they need US-only processing we'll discuss Dedicated/Private pricing separately.

Let's set a 30 minute sync Monday morning if procurement wants to walk through the pack — Sasha, would 8:30am PT work?

Thanks all — assigning action items in the HubSpot deal (link below).

Vivek
